name: h7_missing_credential
description: The vLEI-equivalent chain served with its ECR-AUTH credential withheld. vlei_ecr's edge 'auth' still names ECR-AUTH's real SAID -- a renderer given only the 'served' files must draw an explicit hole at that SAID (Rule 10), not a trimmed edge and not a guessed/manufactured far node (H8's naive lie, applied here to H7).
